fraud_routed_denominator: all labelled fraud; Review plus Block, not confirmed detection
deadline_basis: server acceptance through durable decision storage
timeout_behavior: expired; no simulated execution; transient failures retry only before expiry; late results never execute
review_queue_overflow_behavior: remain queued without automatic Pass or Block; scoring backlog still expires
review_resolver: authorized project-team reviewer; human review has no one-second deadline
final_test_criteria_basis: observed fraud routing and false-block rates; review fraction scaled to 1 and 5 TPS and 8-hour normal day; report confidence intervals; 95 percent capture aspirational
selection_reason: Owner requested more headroom and selected the balanced proposal in chat
policy_approver: project owner via explicit chat approval
approval_timestamp_basis: UTC recording time after receipt of owner approval

activation_workload_acceptance.failure_followup: profile queue, features, inference and database writes; report bottleneck and measured sustainable throughput before proposing revised limits
activation_workload_acceptance.immutable_constraints: one-second deadline, expiry without execution, frozen model and thresholds unchanged; no repeated reserved test
